summary: DeFi Development Corp. filed an 8-K reporting an underwriting agreement dated September 3, 2026, with R.F. Lafferty Co., Inc. as sole book-running manager, for an underwritten offering of 1,375,000 shares of Variable Rate Series C Perpetual Preferred Stock (CHAD) at $8.00 per share, settling September 8, 2026. A 30-day option covers 206,250 additional shares. Net proceeds of approximately $10.3 million, after discounts and expenses, are for general corporate purposes, working capital, SOL acquisitions, and strategic initiatives. The offering was made under an effective Form S-3 shelf registration statement. Watch preferred dividend terms and potential overhang from the underwriter's option.
